articulation.label: rag
articulation.alt: rag: /r/ → /æ/ → /ɡ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/ɡ/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; add voice.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: fin
articulation.alt: fin: /f/ → /ɪ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /f/: Upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: mug
articulation.alt: mug: /m/ → /ʌ/ → /ɡ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
/ɡ/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; add voice.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: peg
articulation.alt: peg: /p/ → /ɛ/ → /ɡ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/ɡ/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; add voice.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
